    What each tradition says

    How we work

    These are traditional systems of belief. They are not science and they do not predict the future. Fate Tutor shows what each tradition says and where it says it, in the language of tendencies.

    We do not give readings about death, lifespan, serious illness, accidents or disasters, even where old texts do.

    For decisions about health, money, law or marriage, please speak to a qualified professional. A traditional reading is a perspective, not advice.

    Your birth details stay on your device and are never sent anywhere. So that they carry from page to page, they are kept in this browser tab until you close it. On a tradition page you can choose “Remember on this device” or “Forget my details”.

    Birth years 1900 to 2100 are supported.
